stories.title: Sources: Cardinals finalizing deal to trade WR Harrison Jr.
stories.summary: The Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade Marvin Harrison Jr., sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Warriors, Podziemski agree to 5-year, $110M extension
stories.summary: Warriors guard Brandin Podziemski has agreed to a five-year, $110 million extension, his agent told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Rangers G Shesterkin out for season with right knee injury
stories.summary: Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin will miss the rest of the season after suffering a right knee injury in Friday night's loss to the Capitals.

stories.title: Sources: Ravens held Jurgens physical at Eagles facility ahead of trade
stories.summary: As the Ravens and Eagles were preparing to agree to a trade that would send Cam Jurgens to Baltimore, the two sides made immediate plans for the center to undergo a physical in Philadelphia before any deal was finalized, league sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Banks, No. 4 in SC Next class of 2027, commits to South Carolina
stories.summary: Jezelle "GG" Banks, the No. 4-ranked player and one of the top point guards in the SC Next class of 2027, has committed to South Carolina.
